slides.title: Git commands that save your project
slides.body: Swipe before your next panic at 2 AM.

slides.title: Check, stage, commit, push
slides.code:
git status
git add .
git commit -m "add login page"
git push
points: Run git status before every commit

slides.title: Never code on main
slides.code:
git switch -c feature/login
# ...work, commit...
git switch main
git merge feature/login

slides.title: Made a mistake? Undo it
slides.code:
git restore app.py
git restore --staged app.py
git commit --amend
git revert <commit-id>
points: revert: undo a pushed commit safely

slides.title: Switch tasks without losing code
slides.code:
git stash
# fix the urgent bug
git stash pop
points: Stash parks changes, pop brings them back

slides.title: What changed, and when?
slides.code:
git log --oneline --graph
git diff
git blame app.py
points: diff shows edits not yet staged

slides.title: Deleted a commit? Find it
points: reflog remembers where HEAD has been
